title: THE INHERITANCE · THE WEEKLY TRANSECT
summary: Issue No. 9's closing ledger, assembled live: 21,627 requests / 4,155 uniques across seven days, with Tuesday's 7,027-request spike landing on a day the desk shipped nothing. Weekly burn 61%, capping ~09-23 at the six-hour pace. OpenRouter -$0.17, eleven overdrawn days. now-condition-reports silent 72 days. E17/E18 closes its fifth issue undecided; the comb's six leads still untriaged.
